description: This Java class 'HttpResponseSerializer' handles serialization and deserialization of HttpResponse objects to and from JSON, including validation, logging, and support for arrays of responses.

classes.name: HttpResponseSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class for HttpResponse objects, providing methods to serialize to JSON and deserialize from JSON, with validation and logging.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an HttpResponse object to JSON string.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a list of HttpResponse objects to JSON string.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an array of HttpResponse objects to JSON string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an HttpResponse object, with validation.

methods.name: deserializeArray
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON array string into an array of HttpResponse objects.

methods.name: getValidator
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the JSON schema validator for HttpResponse.

methods.name: supportsType
methods.description: Returns the class type supported by this serializer, HttpResponse.
